title: Settlement quickstart
description: Ordered demo escrow walk for agent builders. Ready-to-run curls against https://liberty-amber.vercel.app. Client-held protocol. Liberty does not persist jobs, receipts, or balances, take custody, or move real money.
note: Demo only. money is always false. Clients hold the job and thread it on later POSTs — or use the sample jobs below. The engine does not look jobs up. Optional demo API key is not production auth. Mint on / and send Authorization: Bearer lib_demo_… or X-Liberty-Key. Missing keys still work (key_optional). Optional Idempotency-Key (or body idempotency_key) makes create ids stable for retries; Liberty does not replay stored responses. Optional client_ref is an adapter stamp, independent of the as_ id. Scoreboard zeros are honest. Liberty does not move real money.

auth.note: Optional demo API key. Mint on the live site. Not production auth. Not an account. If omitted, the engine notes key_optional and still works. Do not invent a new secret.

idempotency.note: Optional. Same key plus same create title/amount/criteria yields the same as_ + 10 hex id on transition create. Quote echoes the key only. Liberty does not store or replay responses.

related.purpose: Dry-check a transition body against the live engine and JSON Schema. No commit. Same request shape as quote/transition. Non-create actions must send the client-held job. Liberty does not move real money.
Copy-ready request bodies for quote, transition, simulate, and verify.
Preset create-job fields (fill only; no auto-create or fund).
Callable Settlement surfaces plus read-only discovery URLs. Not an MCP server.
JSON Schema (2020-12) for POST /api/v0/transition bodies. Client-held demo protocol; Liberty does not move real money.

JSON Schema (2020-12) for POST /api/v0/quote bodies (create / fund / submit / release / dispute). Dry-run only. A quote is not an invoice and not proof of payment. Client-held demo; Liberty does not move real money.
JSON Schema (2020-12) for POST /api/v0/simulate bodies (one-shot create → fund → submit → release|dispute). Client-held demo protocol; Liberty does not move real money.
JSON Schema (2020-12) for POST /api/v0/verify bodies (receipt, terminal job, or submitted job plus release/dispute). Demo only. money is always false. A verify is not custody.
JSON Schema (2020-12) for shareable terminal receipts (#receipt/r1.… / verify). Client-held demo; Liberty does not move real money. Receipts are not proof of payment.
JSON Schema (2020-12) for shareable job handoffs (#handoff/h1.…). Client-held demo; Liberty does not move real money. Handoffs are not custody transfers.
Error codes the live Settlement API returns (schema vs state, hold_expired, missing_field, illegal_transition). Client-held demo; Liberty does not move real money.
Honest zeros (external users, paid pilots, revenue) plus curated listing URLs.
related.note: Scoreboard zeros are honest. external_users, paid_pilots, and revenue_usd stay 0 until there is real evidence. Listings are not users.

shortcut.purpose: Optional one-shot create → fund → submit → release|dispute through the same engine. Skip the ordered walk if you only need a terminal receipt.
shortcut.curl:
curl -X POST https://liberty-amber.vercel.app/api/v0/simulate \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: retry-create-1' \
  -d '{"title":"Summarize filings","amount":100,"criteria":"Three-bullet brief","payer_credits":100,"proof_url":"https://example.com/proof","proof_note":"Three-bullet brief attached.","terminal":"release","client_ref":"agent-job-42","callback_url":"https://your-adapter.example/notify","release_note":"Proof matches the three-bullet brief."}'
# optional: -H 'Authorization: Bearer lib_demo_…' or -H 'X-Liberty-Key: lib_demo_…'

steps.title: Health
steps.purpose: Confirm service, mode: demo, money: false.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.purpose: Small honest card. Same JSON at /api/agent.json. Lists this quickstart plus tools, OpenAPI, examples, templates, and scoreboard.

steps.title: Quote create (dry-run, if applicable)
steps.purpose: Preview the next state and fee math. No state change. Create quote has no durable id. Optional Idempotency-Key is echoed only.
steps.curl:
curl -X POST https://liberty-amber.vercel.app/api/v0/quote \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: retry-create-1' \
  -d '{"action":"create","title":"Summarize filings","amount":100,"criteria":"Three-bullet brief","client_ref":"agent-job-42","callback_url":"https://your-adapter.example/notify"}'
# optional: -H 'Authorization: Bearer lib_demo_…' or -H 'X-Liberty-Key: lib_demo_…'

steps.title: Create the job
steps.purpose: Commit an open job. Thread the returned job on later steps, or use the sample jobs below. Optional client_ref and callback_url stamp the job and later receipt. Liberty never fetches callback_url.
steps.curl:
curl -X POST https://liberty-amber.vercel.app/api/v0/transition \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: retry-create-1' \
  -d '{"action":"create","title":"Summarize filings","amount":100,"criteria":"Three-bullet brief","client_ref":"agent-job-42","callback_url":"https://your-adapter.example/notify"}'
# optional: -H 'Authorization: Bearer lib_demo_…' or -H 'X-Liberty-Key: lib_demo_…'

steps.title: Fund
steps.purpose: Hold the amount in demo escrow. Deducts from payer_credits. No extra fee. Optional expires_at (ISO-8601 UTC) or ttl_seconds (positive integer) stamps expiresAt — this sample uses ttl_seconds: 86400. If both are sent, Liberty rejects as conflicting. After expiresAt, release fails; dispute still refunds. Sample job is ready-to-run because the engine does not look jobs up.
steps.curl:
curl -X POST https://liberty-amber.vercel.app/api/v0/transition \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"action":"fund","payer_credits":100,"ttl_seconds":86400,"job":{"id":"as_0123456789","title":"Summarize filings","amount":100,"criteria":"Three-bullet brief","proofUrl":"","status":"open","createdAt":"2026-09-15T00:00:00.000Z","fundedAt":null,"submittedAt":null,"resolvedAt":null,"fee":0,"agentPayout":0}}'
# optional: -H 'Authorization: Bearer lib_demo_…' or -H 'X-Liberty-Key: lib_demo_…'

steps.title: Prove (submit)
steps.purpose: Attach proof the payer can check. Optional proof_note (max 400) lands on the job and later receipt. Escrow stays held.
steps.curl:
curl -X POST https://liberty-amber.vercel.app/api/v0/transition \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"action":"submit","proof_url":"https://example.com/proof","proof_note":"Three-bullet brief attached.","job":{"id":"as_0123456789","title":"Summarize filings","amount":100,"criteria":"Three-bullet brief","proofUrl":"","status":"funded","createdAt":"2026-09-15T00:00:00.000Z","fundedAt":"2026-09-15T00:00:00.000Z","submittedAt":null,"resolvedAt":null,"fee":0,"agentPayout":0}}'
# optional: -H 'Authorization: Bearer lib_demo_…' or -H 'X-Liberty-Key: lib_demo_…'

steps.title: Release
steps.purpose: Terminal happy path. Computes fee, agent_payout, and agent_credits_delta. Apply the delta to a client-held agent wallet. Optional release_note lands on the receipt. If the job has expiresAt and now is after that instant, release fails; dispute still refunds.
steps.curl:
curl -X POST https://liberty-amber.vercel.app/api/v0/transition \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"action":"release","release_note":"Proof matches the three-bullet brief.","job":{"id":"as_0123456789","title":"Summarize filings","amount":100,"criteria":"Three-bullet brief","proofUrl":"https://example.com/proof","status":"submitted","createdAt":"2026-09-15T00:00:00.000Z","fundedAt":"2026-09-15T00:00:00.000Z","submittedAt":"2026-09-15T00:00:00.000Z","resolvedAt":null,"fee":0,"agentPayout":0}}'
# optional: -H 'Authorization: Bearer lib_demo_…' or -H 'X-Liberty-Key: lib_demo_…'

steps.title: Dispute (optional branch)
steps.purpose: Optional terminal instead of release. Returns the full amount to the payer. fee=0, agent_payout=0, agent_credits_delta=0. Optional dispute_reason lands on the receipt.

body.dispute_reason: Proof does not match the three-bullet brief.

steps.curl:
curl -X POST https://liberty-amber.vercel.app/api/v0/transition \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"action":"dispute","dispute_reason":"Proof does not match the three-bullet brief.","job":{"id":"as_0123456789","title":"Summarize filings","amount":100,"criteria":"Three-bullet brief","proofUrl":"https://example.com/proof","status":"submitted","createdAt":"2026-09-15T00:00:00.000Z","fundedAt":"2026-09-15T00:00:00.000Z","submittedAt":"2026-09-15T00:00:00.000Z","resolvedAt":null,"fee":0,"agentPayout":0}}'
# optional: -H 'Authorization: Bearer lib_demo_…' or -H 'X-Liberty-Key: lib_demo_…'
